task_contract.anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink.

runtime_boundary.event_plane: DOM CustomEvent on the main document with local async continuations

evidence: The DevTools-visible corpus is a single hard-style bundle without an exposed source map.
The target field name is assembled from character-code arrays at the sink, so direct literal search is incomplete.
The target value is carried through a reducer factory, selected slot, dynamic payload field and console wrapper.
The inventory snapshot route selects its live profile after row selection, board-state collection, tuple shape and state-machine outputs are available.

The click path crosses row selection capture, intent routing, lane matrix routing, board-state collection, tuple construction, deferred scheduling, local state-plane dispatch, policy middleware, ledger-machine reduction, profile selection, state encoding and sink wrapping.
The bundle contains shadow state outputs in debug/info, dataset and window cache locations that do not feed the target console.log state_code.
Vendor-like files and alternate reducer rows are imported into the same bundle and resemble target-producing code.
The target state code is separated from the click by Promise, microtask, timer, animation-frame and MutationObserver boundaries.
The selected reducer slot and runtime ticket are computed before the anchor receives tuple, route and machine state.
The final sink receives an already encoded value under a dynamically assembled field name.

challenge_analysis.construct_validity_note: Primary bottleneck is semantic disambiguation among similarly named path functions in a large bundle; keyword search narrows high-score candidates but does not replace tracing the inventory.snapshot path.

behavior_category.subtype: inventory board snapshot and runtime route state code
behavior_category.reason: The observable value is a compact deterministic encoding of inventory board state, row selection, route state, tuple shape and runtime machine state. It is not a request signature, byte-array payload, browser fingerprint or request-body rewrite.

near_categories.why_not: The output is named state_code and represents UI/runtime state; signature-like decoys do not feed the requested field.
No network request body is emitted or rewritten; the target is a console-observable state encoding.
The target is a string state code, not a byte buffer or binary payload transform.
